## Design

### 2026-10-07 — Started working on Starbie and went through the Week 1 guide to understand the project requirements. I learned that Starbie involves designing a PCB in KiCad and later adding firmware using an ESP32-C

**2h**

Started working on Starbie and went through the Week 1 guide to understand the project requirements. I learned that Starbie involves designing a PCB in KiCad and later adding firmware using an ESP32-C3, OLED, buttons, MPU6050, and DHT11 sensor. I also set up my plan for starting the PCB design.
